subtitle.user: Quick guide to using EnergyMonitor at home.

user.title: Create your account
user.body: Sign up with your email and a password, accept the terms and enter the six-digit code sent to your email. You can also sign in with Google. The account is created once the email is verified.

user.title: Homes
user.body: Create a home or join one with the access code its owner shared with you. The owner can invite people, remove members, transfer the home and set the daily and monthly consumption limits. Mark homes as favorites to find them quickly.

user.title: Link a meter
user.body: In the home, open Devices and choose Link. It is done over Bluetooth: the meter receives your Wi-Fi network and connects. You will see whether it is online and when it sent its last reading.

user.title: Consumption and history
user.body: The dashboard shows the current power, today's and this month's consumption and a chart of the last 24 hours. The history lets you pick a date range and see consumption per device.

user.title: Alerts and recommendations
user.body: You get an alert when the home exceeds its limit, when a meter disconnects or when an appliance uses far more than usual. Saving recommendations come from your own consumption.

user.title: Notifications
user.body: In Settings you choose whether alerts arrive by email or as push notifications on this phone. If you deny the system permission, you can grant it from the phone's settings.

user.title: My account
user.body: Change your first name, last name and photo, and enlarge the photo from the app. You can change your password or delete the account: with your password, or with a code sent by email if you signed in with Google.

user.title: Technical support
user.body: If something does not work, go to Settings → Help center and press Create ticket: an email opens with the subject already written for the support team, without leaving the app.
